name: mesh-live
description: Live Claude Agents Mesh inside Claude Code: inbox that wakes the agent, real quota reports, automatic task leases and handoff, a /mesh pane, commands, status line, live context, file locks and token masking.

mesh_server.title: Mesh MCP server name
mesh_server.description: The mesh MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. If it is not found, 'mesh', 'Claude mesh' and 'plugin:claude-agents-mesh:mesh' are tried.

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Display name used with register_session. Empty keeps the name already registered.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the mesh is polled (presence, tasks, messages). Minimum 10.

wake_on_message.title: Wake on new message
wake_on_message.description: Start a turn when a new mesh message arrives while the session is idle.

wake_on_task.title: Wake on new task
wake_on_task.description: Start a turn when a new pending task appears and this agent holds none.

show_band.title: Inbox band
show_band.description: Show unread messages and free tasks in a band above the prompt.

show_status.title: Status line
show_status.description: Show agents, tasks, messages and quota in the status line.

report_quota.title: Report quota
report_quota.description: Report the real rate-limit windows to the mesh (warning, blocked, reset).

quota_thresholds.title: Quota warning thresholds
quota_thresholds.description: Comma-separated percentages at which a quota_warning is reported once per window.

auto_handoff.title: Automatic handoff
auto_handoff.description: Near the quota limit, write a handoff note, release the tasks held and tell the other agents.

handoff_threshold.title: Handoff threshold (%)
handoff_threshold.description: Rate-limit percentage that triggers the automatic handoff.

keep_leases.title: Keep task leases
keep_leases.description: Renew the lease of every task this agent holds on each poll.

release_on_exit.title: Release tasks on exit
release_on_exit.description: Release the tasks held and go offline when the session ends.

inject_context.title: Live mesh context
inject_context.description: Give the model the mesh state with each prompt, whenever it changed.

file_lock.title: File locks
file_lock.description: What happens before editing a file another agent's task declares: warn, deny or off.

mask_tokens.title: Mask mesh tokens
mask_tokens.description: Mask mesh_ tokens wherever the transcript draws them.
